text: # 엣지엑스 MQTT 수집 수직 슬라이스 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: Build the first EdgeX-only physical-device canary: convert one vibration device's canonical factory telemetry into EdgeX Device MQTT async events, read the latest event from Core Data, and use it as the first gated step in retiring MapperFramework from the physical-device path. Architecture: A temporary compatibility bridge subscribes to factory/devices/{device-name}/telemetry, validates and projects the payload through a route profile, and republishes it to incoming/data/{device-name}/{source-name}. Stock EdgeX device-mqtt v4.0.2 owns the registered device/profile and persists Event/Readings through MessageBus/Core Data. Once the canary route is enabled, KubeEdge DeviceStatus and MapperFramework must not process the same physical device; KubeEdge remains only for node/workload management. Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, paho-mqtt 2.x, PyYAML 6.x, pytest 8.x, Mosquitto 2.x, Docker Compose, EdgeX Foundry v4.0.2, PostgreSQL. ## Global Constraints - Run every shell command through rtk. - Use applypatch for repository file edits. - Apply TDD: each production behavior must have a test that was observed failing first. - Target edge node is etri-dev0001-jetorn. - Input broker is the edge-local Mosquitto endpoint, normally 127.0.0.1:1883 for host publishers. - Canonical input topic is factory/devices/{device-name}/telemetry. - EdgeX async topic is incoming/data/{device-name}/{source-name}. - First device is vib-arduino-acceleration-01; first source is telemetry. - EdgeX release is pinned to stable tag v4.0.2; do not use main or latest. - The no-security EdgeX profile is allowed only for the isolated PoC and its APIs bind to loopback. - Do not add raw telemetry fields to KubeEdge DeviceStatus or add a new MapperFramework telemetry sink. - Remove the canary from active MapperFramework/DeviceStatus ownership before enabling its EdgeX route; no dual owner or fallback. - Do not couple or replace sensor-collector/ or virtual-device/ in this slice. - Do not claim InfluxDB/App Service, AI consumers, command execution, RTSP, Serial, Modbus, OPC-UA, or all-device migration complete from this ingestion proof. - Preserve all unrelated dirty-worktree changes. --- ## File Structure edgex/ ├── README.md ├── compose/ │ └── docker-compose.override.yml ├── device-config/ │ ├── devices/ │ │ └── vib-arduino-acceleration-01.yaml │ └── profiles/ │ └── etri-vibration-mqtt.yaml ├── mqtt-bridge/ │ ├── Dockerfile │ ├── pyproject.toml │ ├── config/ │ │ └── vibration.yaml │ ├── src/mqtt_edge_bridge/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── config.py │ │ ├── health.py │ │ ├── main.py │ │ ├── models.py │ │ ├── service.py │ │ └── transform.py │ └── tests/ │ ├── test_broker_integration.py │ ├── test_config.py │ ├── test_edgex_config.py │ ├── test_health.py │ ├── test_service.py │ └── test_transform.py └── scripts/ ├── smoke_test.py └── test_smoke_test.py config.py owns YAML parsing and startup validation. transform.py is pure and owns topic lookup, allowlist projection, type conversion, and timestamp validation. service.py owns MQTT callbacks and counters. health.py owns the container-readable lifecycle file. main.py only wires configuration, paho, signals, and process exit. --- ### Task 1: Route Configuration and Startup Validation Files: - Create: edgex/mqtt-bridge/pyproject.toml - Create: edgex/mqtt-bridge/src/mqttedgebridge/init.py - Create: edgex/mqtt-bridge/src/mqttedgebridge/models.py - Create: edgex/mqtt-bridge/src/mqttedgebridge/config.py - Create: edgex/mqtt-bridge/config/vibration.yaml - Test: edgex/mqtt-bridge/tests/testconfig.py Interfaces: - Consumes: YAML mapping with broker, ignoreRetained, and routes. - Produces: loadconfig(path: Path) -> BridgeConfig, immutable BrokerConfig, FieldMapping, Route, and BridgeConfig values. - [ ] Step 1: Create packaging metadata and the failing configuration tests Create pyproject.toml with this exact dependency boundary: [build-system] requires = ["setuptools>=75"] build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta" [project] name = "etri-mqtt-edge-bridge" version = "0.1.0" requires-python = ">=3.11" dependencies = [ "paho-mqtt>=2.1,<3", "PyYAML>=6.0,<7", ] [project.optional-dependencies] test = ["pytest>=8,<9"] [tool.setuptools] package-dir = {"" = "src"} [tool.setuptools.packages.find] where = ["src"] [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths = ["tests"] markers = ["integration: requires a local mosquitto executable"] Create tests that define the desired API before production modules exist: from pathlib import Path import pytest import yaml from mqtt_edge_bridge.config import ConfigError, load_config VALID = """ broker: host: 127.0.0.1 port: 1883 clientId: etri-mqtt-edge-bridge qos: 1 keepaliveSeconds: 60 reconnectMinSeconds: 1 reconnectMaxSeconds: 30 ignoreRetained: true routes: - inputTopic: factory/devices/vib-arduino-acceleration-01/telemetry deviceName: vib-arduino-acceleration-01 sourceName: telemetry outputTopic: incoming/data/vib-arduino-acceleration-01/telemetry timestampFields: [source_ts, ts, timestamp] fields: x: {target: acceleration_x, type: float} y: {target: acceleration_y, type: float} z: {target: acceleration_z, type: float} """ def write_config(tmp_path: Path, text: str = VALID) -> Path: path = tmp_path / "bridge.yaml" path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8") return path def test_load_config_builds_immutable_route(tmp_path: Path) -> None: config = load_config(write_config(tmp_path)) route = config.routes[0] assert config.broker.qos == 1 assert config.ignore_retained is True assert route.device_name == "vib-arduino-acceleration-01" assert route.output_topic == "incoming/data/vib-arduino-acceleration-01/telemetry" assert [field.target for field in route.fields] == [ "acceleration_x", "acceleration_y", "acceleration_z", ] def test_output_topic_must_match_device_and_source(tmp_path: Path) -> None: invalid = VALID.replace( "incoming/data/vib-arduino-acceleration-01/telemetry", "incoming/data/another-device/telemetry", ) with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="outputTopic must equal"): load_config(write_config(tmp_path, invalid)) def test_duplicate_input_topic_is_rejected(tmp_path: Path) -> None: data = yaml.safe_load(VALID) data["routes"].append(dict(data["routes"][0])) invalid = yaml.safe_dump(data, sort_keys=False) with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="duplicate inputTopic"): load_config(write_config(tmp_path, invalid)) - [ ] Step 2: Install the editable test environment and verify RED Run: rtk python3 -m venv .venv rtk .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[test]' rtk .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_config.py -v Working directory: edgex/mqtt-bridge Expected: collection fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mqttedgebridge.config'. - [ ] Step 3: Implement immutable models and strict YAML parsing Implement these public types in models.py: from dataclasses import dataclass @dataclass(frozen=True) class BrokerConfig: host: str port: int client_id: str qos: int keepalive_seconds: int reconnect_min_seconds: int reconnect_max_seconds: int @dataclass(frozen=True) class FieldMapping: source: str target: str value_type: str @dataclass(frozen=True) class Route: input_topic: str device_name: str source_name: str output_topic: str timestamp_fields: tuple[str, ...] fields: tuple[FieldMapping, ...] @dataclass(frozen=True) class BridgeConfig: broker: BrokerConfig ignore_retained: bool routes: tuple[Route, ...] Implement ConfigError(ValueError) and loadconfig() in config.py. It must: def load_config(path: Path) -> BridgeConfig: raw = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) root = _mapping(raw, "root") broker_raw = _mapping(root.get("broker"), "broker") broker = BrokerConfig( host=_text(broker_raw.get("host"), "broker.host"), port=_integer(broker_raw.get("port"), "broker.port", minimum=1, maximum=65535), client_id=_text(broker_raw.get("clientId"), "broker.clientId"), qos=_integer(broker_raw.get("qos"), "broker.qos", minimum=0, maximum=2), keepalive_seconds=_integer( broker_raw.get("keepaliveSeconds"), "broker.keepaliveSeconds", minimum=3 ), reconnect_min_seconds=_integer( broker_raw.get("reconnectMinSeconds"), "broker.reconnectMinSeconds", minimum=1 ), reconnect_max_seconds=_integer( broker_raw.get("reconnectMaxSeconds"), "broker.reconnectMaxSeconds", minimum=1 ), ) if broker.reconnect_max_seconds < broker.reconnect_min_seconds: raise ConfigError("broker.reconnectMaxSeconds must be >= reconnectMinSeconds") routes = tuple(_route(item, index) for index, item in enumerate(_list(root.get("routes"), "routes"))) if not routes: raise ConfigError("routes must not be empty") topics = [route.input_topic for route in routes] if len(topics) != len(set(topics)): raise ConfigError("duplicate inputTopic") return BridgeConfig( broker=broker, ignore_retained=_boolean(root.get("ignoreRetained"), "ignoreRetained"), routes=routes, ) route() must accept only non-empty field maps, support only type: float in this slice, reject duplicate target names, and enforce: def _mapping(value: object, name: str) -> dict[str, object]: if not isinstance(value, dict): raise ConfigError(f"{name} must be a mapping") return value def _list(value: object, name: str) -> list[object]: if not isinstance(value, list): raise ConfigError(f"{name} must be a list") return value def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str: if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip(): raise ConfigError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string") return value.strip() def _integer( value: object, name: str, *, minimum: int, maximum: int | None = None, ) -> int: if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int): raise ConfigError(f"{name} must be an integer") if value < minimum or (maximum is not None and value > maximum): raise ConfigError(f"{name} is outside the allowed range") return value def _boolean(value: object, name: str) -> bool: if not isinstance(value, bool): raise ConfigError(f"{name} must be a boolean") return value def _route(value: object, index: int) -> Route: raw = _mapping(value, f"routes[{index}]") input_topic = _text(raw.get("inputTopic"), f"routes[{index}].inputTopic") device_name = _text(raw.get("deviceName"), f"routes[{index}].deviceName") source_name = _text(raw.get("sourceName"), f"routes[{index}].sourceName") output_topic = _text(raw.get("outputTopic"), f"routes[{index}].outputTopic") expected = f"incoming/data/{device_name}/{source_name}" if output_topic != expected: raise ConfigError(f"routes[{index}].outputTopic must equal {expected}") timestamp_fields = tuple( _text(item, f"routes[{index}].timestampFields") for item in _list(raw.get("timestampFields"), f"routes[{index}].timestampFields") ) if not timestamp_fields: raise ConfigError(f"routes[{index}].timestampFields must not be empty") fields_raw = _mapping(raw.get("fields"), f"routes[{index}].fields") fields: list[FieldMapping] = [] for source, definition in fields_raw.items(): source_name_field = _text(source, f"routes[{index}].fields source") field_raw = _mapping(definition, f"routes[{index}].fields.{source_name_field}") target = _text(field_raw.get("target"), f"routes[{index}].fields.{source}.target") value_type = _text(field_raw.get("type"), f"routes[{index}].fields.{source}.type") if value_type != "float": raise ConfigError(f"routes[{index}].fields.{source}.type must be float") fields.append(FieldMapping(source_name_field, target, value_type)) if not fields: raise ConfigError(f"routes[{index}].fields must not be empty") targets = [field.target for field in fields] if len(targets) != len(set(targets)): raise ConfigError(f"routes[{index}] has duplicate field targets") return Route( input_topic=input_topic, device_name=device_name, source_name=source_name, output_topic=output_topic, timestamp_fields=timestamp_fields, fields=tuple(fields), ) - [ ] Step 4: Add the approved vibration route and verify GREEN Create config/vibration

title: 엣지엑스 중앙 코어와 엣지 버퍼 구현 계획
description: > For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-dri…
text: # 엣지엑스 중앙 코어와 엣지 버퍼 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: 센서가 연결된 KubeEdge 노드에는 MQTT 수집·SQLite 임시 버퍼 agent 한 개만 두고, etri-ser0002-cgnmsb의 EdgeX Core Data와 PostgreSQL에 저장 확인 기반으로 telemetry를 통합 보관하는 MQTT 수직 슬라이스를 구현한다. Architecture: 로컬 Mosquitto를 구독하는 ARM64 edge agent가 EdgeX Event UUID를 생성하고 SQLite outbox에 먼저 commit한 뒤 HTTPS ingest gateway로 전송한다. amd64 중앙 gateway는 제한된 POST /v1/events만 제공하고 EdgeX Core Data 4.0.2의 Add Event API 결과와 ID 조회를 이용해 PostgreSQL 저장 또는 동일 Event 재전송을 확인한다. 기존 Jetson 전체 EdgeX stack은 canary 전환이 끝날 때까지 그대로 보존한다. Tech Stack: Python 3.12, paho-mqtt 2.x, PyYAML 6.x, SQLite WAL, Python standard-library HTTP/TLS, pytest 8.x, EdgeX Foundry 4.0.2, PostgreSQL 16.3, Kubernetes/KubeEdge, Kustomize, Argo CD, Kaniko, private registry 192.168.0.56:5000. ## Global Constraints - 모든 repository shell command는 rtk로 시작한다. - EdgeX release는 4.0.2로 고정한다. amd64 image는 edgexfoundry/core-keeper:4.0.2, edgexfoundry/core-common-config-bootstrapper:4.0.2, edgexfoundry/core-data:4.0.2, edgexfoundry/core-metadata:4.0.2를 사용한다. - 중앙 workload는 etri-ser0002-cgnmsb(amd64, InternalIP 192.168.0.5)에만 배치한다. - edge agent는 edgeai.etrilab/sensor-gateway=true인 ARM64 EdgeCore 노드에만 배치한다. - 현재 source adapter는 MQTT 하나이며 입력 topic은 factory/devices/{device-name}/telemetry다. - Modbus, OPC-UA와 RTSP adapter 및 actuator command는 이번 수직 슬라이스에 포함하지 않는다. RTSP frame은 이 outbox에 넣지 않는다. - outbox 경로는 /var/lib/edge-telemetry-buffer/outbox.db, 기본 한도는 24시간 또는 1GiB 중 먼저 도달한 조건이다. - outbox record는 Core Data 201 또는 동일 UUID의 저장 내용 확인 뒤에만 삭제한다. MQTT PUBACK은 삭제 근거가 아니다. - Core Data Writable.PersistData=true를 manifest와 live write/read smoke 양쪽에서 검증한다. - raw telemetry를 KubeEdge DeviceStatus에 기록하지 않고 KubeEdge Device/DeviceModel CRD를 변경하지 않는다. - 외부 endpoint는 https://192.168.0.5:30443/v1/events 하나다. Core Data, Metadata, Keeper, MessageBus와 PostgreSQL은 ClusterIP다. - TLS private key와 bearer token은 Git에 commit하지 않는다. live namespace에 사전 생성한 Secret을 mount한다. - 기존 telemetry namespace의 Jetson EdgeX workload와 PVC는 삭제하지 않는다. - image build tag는 192.168.0.56:5000/edge-telemetry-agent:0.1.0과 192.168.0.56:5000/edgex-ingest-gateway:0.1.0이고, Deployment에는 registry가 반환한 immutable digest를 사용한다. - 구현은 TDD 순서로 진행하고 각 task가 통과할 때 별도 commit한다. --- ## File Structure edgex/telemetry-plane/ ├── .dockerignore ├── Dockerfile.agent ├── Dockerfile.gateway ├── pyproject.toml ├── config/ │ ├── vibration.yaml │ └── main.py │ ├── metadata_bootstrap.py │ └── server.py └── tests/ ├── conftest.py ├── test_agent_config.py ├── test_agent_service.py ├── test_contract.py ├── test_gateway_application.py ├── test_gateway_client.py ├── test_health.py ├── test_metadata_bootstrap.py ├── test_mqtt_integration.py ├── test_outbox.py └── test_transform.py edgex/k8s/ ├── base/ │ ├── server/ │ │ ├── config/messagebus/mosquitto.conf │ │ ├── config/profiles/etri-vibration-central.yaml │ │ ├── config/routes/vibration.yaml │ │ ├── config-bootstrapper.yaml │ │ ├── core-data.yaml │ │ ├── sensor-gateways/kustomization.yaml └── tests/ ├── test_central_manifests.py └── test_edge_agent_manifests.py edgex/scripts/ ├── central_k8s_smoke_test.py ├── k8s_build_telemetry_images.py ├── provision_edgex_ingest_secrets.sh ├── test_central_k8s_smoke_test.py └── test_k8s_build_telemetry_images.py The existing edgex/mqtt-bridge/, root edgex/k8s/.yaml, and telemetry namespace remain the immutable legacy canary path until the final cutover decision. --- ### Task 1: Activate the Central Telemetry Plane Scope and Configuration Contract Files: - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/pyproject.toml - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/config/vibration.yaml - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/config/profiles/etri-vibration-central.yaml - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/src/edgetelemetryagent/init.py - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/src/edgetelemetryagent/models.py - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/src/edgetelemetryagent/config.py - Create: edgex/telemetry-plane/tests/testagentconfig.py - Modify: docs/프로젝트-범위.md - Modify: docs/저장소-구조.md - Modify: docs/원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md Interfaces: - Produces: loadconfig(path: Path) -> AgentConfig, loadroutes(path: Path) -> tuple[Route, ...]. - Produces: immutable BrokerConfig, GatewayConfig, BufferConfig, HealthConfig, FieldMapping, Route, and AgentConfig dataclasses. - Produces: one Git-owned route/profile pair shared by the agent, gateway allowlist, and metadata bootstrap. - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing configuration tests from pathlib import Path import pytest from edge_telemetry_agent.config import ConfigError, load_config, load_routes CONFIG = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "config" / "vibration.yaml" def test_load_config_has_exact_testbed_contract() -> None: config = load_config(CONFIG) route = config.routes[0] assert config.broker.host == "127.0.0.1" assert config.gateway.url == "https://192.168.0.5:30443/v1/events" assert config.buffer.path.as_posix() paho-mqtt>=2.1,<3, and test dependency pytest>=8,<9. models.py must define the exact dataclasses named in the interface block. config.py must reject unknown or missing top-level objects, duplicate input topics, non-HTTPS gateway URLs, unsupported timestamp units, unsupported value types, and duplicate resource names. Use this route shape verbatim in config/vibration.yaml: broker: host: 127.0.0.1 port: 1883 clientId: edge-telemetry-agent qos: 1 keepaliveSeconds: 60 gateway: url: https://192.168.0.5:30443/v1/events tokenFile: /var/run/secrets/edgex-ingest/token caFile: /var/run/edgex-ca/ca.crt timeoutSeconds: 5 buffer: path: /var/lib/edge-telemetry-buffer/outbox.db maxBytes: 1073741824 maxAgeSeconds: 86400 retryMinSeconds: 1 retryMaxSeconds: 60 drainPerSecond: 100 health: host: 0.0.0.0 port: 8080 ignoreRetained: true routes: - inputTopic: factory/devices/vib-arduino-acceleration-01/telemetry deviceName: vib-arduino-acceleration-01 profileName: etri-vibration-central sourceName: telemetry timestampFields: [source_ts, ts, timestamp] timestampUnit: s fields: x: {resourceName: acceleration_x, valueType: Float64} y: {resourceName: acceleration_y, valueType: Float64} z: {resourceName: acceleration_z, valueType: Float64} The EdgeX profile must define the same three Float64 resources and one hidden read-only telemetry device command. # 대시보드 데이터 소스 장애 격리 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: EdgeX device 관측 실패를 device 영역에만 격리해 /state/dashboard가 node와 다른 독립 상태를 계속 반환하고 표시하게 한다. Architecture: FastAPI 집계 경계에서 예상 가능한 EdgeXError만 잡아 devices=[]와 명시적인 deviceobservationerror를 반환한다. 브라우저는 이 필드를 source 장애로 표시하고 node/workload/resource 렌더링을 계속한다. Tech Stack: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, pytest, vanilla JavaScript, Node.js node:test ## Global Constraints - 물리 device inventory/state/telemetry의 authority는 EdgeX다. - EdgeX 관측 실패를 실제 device inventory 0개로 설명하지 않는다. - Kubernetes node 상태는 EdgeX device availability와 별도 영역으로 유지한다. - 마지막 성공 device 값을 캐시하거나 stale 값을 정상 데이터로 표시하지 않는다. - 기존 미커밋 EdgeX authority 전환 변경을 보존한다. - Kubernetes/EdgeX runtime mutation과 배포는 이 계획 범위에 포함하지 않는다. - 대상 파일에 기존 사용자 변경이 있으므로 구현 결과는 커밋하지 않고 검토 가능한 working-tree diff로 남긴다. --- ### Task 1: Backend partial-degraded contract Files: - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testdashboardresilience.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/models.py:214-221 - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/main.py:11-31,126-144 Interfaces: - Consumes: app.edgex.EdgeXError, StateAggregatorService.getdevices() - Produces: DashboardState.deviceobservationerror: str | None - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing API regression tests from datetime import datetime, timezone from app.edgex import EdgeXBackendError from app.models import NodeState def _healthy_node() -> NodeState: return NodeState( hostname="etri-ser0001-cg0msb", instance="192.168.0.56:9100", node_type="cloud_server", collected_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc), raw_metrics={"up": 1.0}, compute_pressure="low", memory_pressure="low", network_pressure="low", node_health="healthy", ) def test_dashboard_endpoint_isolates_edgex_device_observation_failure(monkeypatch): async def failing_devices(): raise EdgeXBackendError("Core Metadata unavailable") async def fake_resource_state(refresh=False): return {"summary": {}, "service_resource_profiles": []} monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_nodes", lambda: [_healthy_node()]) monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_devices", failing_devices) monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_workflows", lambda: []) monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_resource_profile_state", fake_resource_state) with TestClient(app) as client: response = client.get("/state/dashboard") assert response.status_code == 200 payload = response.json() assert [node["hostname"] for node in payload["nodes"]] == ["etri-ser0001-cg0msb"] assert payload["devices"] == [] assert payload["device_observation_error"] == ( "EdgeX device observation unavailable: EdgeXBackendError" ) def test_dashboard_endpoint_has_no_device_observation_error_when_edgex_is_available(monkeypatch): async def fake_devices(): return [] async def fake_resource_state(refresh=False): return {"summary": {}, "service_resource_profiles": []} monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_nodes", lambda: []) monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_devices", fake_devices) monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_workflows", lambda: []) monkeypatch.setattr(service, "get_resource_profile_state", fake_resource_state) with TestClient(app) as client: response = client.get("/state/dashboard") assert response.status_code == 200 assert response.json()["device_observation_error"] is None - [ ] Step 2: Run the focused tests and verify RED Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator pytest -q tests/test_dashboard_resilience.py -k device_observation Expected: the failure-isolation test receives 500 because EdgeXBackendError escapes dashboardstate(), and the normal test lacks deviceobservationerror. - [ ] Step 3: Add the response field and isolate only EdgeX errors In app/models.py: class DashboardState(BaseModel): generated_at: datetime nodes: list[NodeState] devices: list[DeviceState] workflows: list[WorkflowState] summary: SummaryState kpis: dict[str, Any] resource_profiles: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict) device_observation_error: str | None = None In app/main.py, import EdgeXError and change the device boundary: from .edgex import EdgeXError async def _dashboard_state() -> DashboardState: nodes = service.get_nodes() device_observation_error: str | None = None try: devices = await service.get_devices() except EdgeXError as exc: devices = [] device_observation_error = ( f"EdgeX device observation unavailable: {exc.__class__.__name__}" ) workflows = service.get_workflows() kpis = service._build_dashboard_kpis(nodes, devices, workflows) try: resource_state = await service.get_resource_profile_state() except httpx.HTTPError as exc: resource_state = _resource_observation_error_state(exc) kpis.update(service._build_resource_profile_kpis(resource_state)) return DashboardState( generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc), nodes=nodes, devices=devices, workflows=workflows, summary=service.get_summary(), kpis=kpis, resource_profiles=resource_state, device_observation_error=device_observation_error, ) - [ ] Step 4: Run the focused tests and verify GREEN Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator pytest -q tests/test_dashboard_resilience.py -k device_observation Expected: both device observation tests pass. ### Task 2: Frontend source-error presentation Files: - Create: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testdashboardsourceisolation.js - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/static/dashboard.js:600-643,813-840,1027-1064,1209-1235 Interfaces: - Consumes: DashboardState.deviceobservationerror - Produces: deviceFilterEmptyText(data) and buildDashboardAlerts(data) pure helpers - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing JavaScript tests const test = require("node:test"); const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const { buildDashboardAlerts, deviceFilterEmptyText, } = require("../app/static/dashboard.js"); test("shows EdgeX observation failure instead of empty inventory", () => { const data = { device_observation_error: "EdgeX device observation unavailable: EdgeXBackendError", nodes: [], devices: [], }; assert.equal(deviceFilterEmptyText(data), "EdgeX device 관측 불가"); assert.deepEqual(buildDashboardAlerts(data), [ { kind: "source", level: "high", title: "EdgeX device observation unavailable", text: "EdgeX device observation unavailable: EdgeXBackendError", }, ]); }); test("keeps the normal empty inventory message when EdgeX observation succeeds", () => { assert.equal( deviceFilterEmptyText({ device_observation_error: null }), "EdgeX Core Metadata device가 없습니다.", ); }); - [ ] Step 2: Run the JavaScript test and verify RED Run: node --test edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/test_dashboard_source_isolation.js Expected: FAIL because buildDashboardAlerts and the parameterized deviceFilterEmptyText contract do not exist. - [ ] Step 3: Add pure presentation helpers and use them in rendering Add these pure helpers in dashboard.js: function deviceObservationUnavailable(data = state.data) { return Boolean(data?.device_observation_error); } function deviceFilterEmptyText(data = state.data) { if (deviceObservationUnavailable(data)) return "EdgeX device 관측 불가"; if (state.selectedNodeName) return `${state.selectedNodeName}에 맞는 EdgeX device가 없습니다.`; return "EdgeX Core Metadata device가 없습니다."; } function buildDashboardAlerts(data = {}) { const alerts = []; if (data.device_observation_error) { alerts.push({ kind: "source", level: "high", title: "EdgeX device observation unavailable", text: data.device_observation_error, }); } for (const [index, node] of (data.nodes || []).entries()) { if (node.node_health !== "healthy") { const displayName = nodeDisplayName(node, index); alerts.push({ kind: "node", level: node.node_health === "unavailable" ? "high" : "medium", title: `${displayName}: non-healthy node`, text: `${displayName}: non-healthy node (${node.node_health})`, node, }); } } for (const device of data.devices || []) { const status = deviceStatus(device); const reasons = []; if (status === "degraded" || status === "unavailable") reasons.push(status); if (device.connection_state !== "connected") reasons.push(`connection=${text(device.connection_state, "unknown")}`); if (device.telemetry_freshness !== "fresh") reasons.push(`event=${text(device.telemetry_freshness, "no_events")}`); if (reasons.length) { alerts.push({ kind: "device", level: status === "unavailable" ? "high" : "medium", title: `${device.name}: ${reasons.join(", ")}`, text: `${device.name}: ${reasons.join(", ")} · ${deviceReason(device)}`, device, }); } } return alerts.slice(0, 12); } Change the device empty-state call with this exact diff: -function renderDevices(devices) { +function renderDevices(devices, data = state.data) { const visibleDevices = filteredDevices(devices); @@ - : `
${escapeHtml(deviceFilterEmptyText())}
`; + : `
${escapeHtml(deviceFilterEmptyText(data))}
`; Replace renderAlerts with: function renderAlerts(data) { state.alerts = buildDashboardAlerts(data); $("alertList").innerHTML = state.alerts.length ? state.alerts .map((alert, index) => `
${escapeHtml(alert.text)}
`) .join("") : `
No active alerts
`; } Do not change the device row template. In render(), set const deviceObservationFailed = deviceObservationUnavailable(data). For deviceCount, deviceHealthRatio, telemetryFreshnessRatio, telemetryFreshnessCaption, serviceBindingRatio, serviceBindingCaption, and riskCount, use 관측 불가 or the sanitized data.deviceobservationerror when true and retain the current expressions when false. Call renderAlerts(data) and renderDevices(devices, data). In renderOverviewVisuals(), use { ok: 0, warn: 0, bad: 0, unknown: 1 } for the status ring during an EdgeX observation failure. Set overallHealthPercent, overviewHealthCaption, deviceAvailableValue, telemetryFreshValue, and bindingValue to 관측 불가; set the related bars to 0; set the four device status counts to -. Keep node, CPU, memory, GPU, and resource coverage values on their existing paths. Add these exact entries to the existing CommonJS export object: if (typeof module !== "undefined") { module.exports = { + buildDashboardAlerts, + deviceFilterEmptyText, + deviceObservationUnavailable, explainDeviceRules, - [ ] Step 4: Run the JavaScript test and syntax check Run: node --test edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/test_dashboard_source_isolation.js node --check edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/static/dashboard.js Expected: tests pass and syntax check exits 0. ### Task 3: Regression verification Files: - Verify only: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/ - Verify only: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/ Interfaces: - Consumes: Task 1 API contract and Task 2 rendering helpers - Produces: verified working-tree implementation ready for review/deployment by the user - [ ] Step 1: Run focused backend and frontend suites cd edge-orch/state-aggregator pytest -q tests/test_dashboard_resilience.py tests/test_api.py tests/test_edgex.py cd ../../ node --test edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/test_dashboard_source_isolation.js Expected: all selected tests pass. - [ ] Step 2: Run the full state-aggregator Python suite cd edge-orch/state-aggregator pytest -q Expected: all tests pass with no new warnings or errors. - [ ] Step 3: Validate the final diff without staging user changes git diff --check -- edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/main.py edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/models.py edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/static/dashboard.js edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/test_dashboard_resilience.py edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/test_dashboard_source_isolation.js git status --short -- edge-orch/state-aggregator Expected: no whitespace errors; only the intended files plus pre-existing user changes remain in the working tree.

title: EdgeX 디바이스 조회 단일 실행 구현 계획
description: > For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-dri…
text: # EdgeX 디바이스 조회 단일 실행 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: Prevent concurrent state-aggregator endpoints from issuing duplicate EdgeX device observations that exhaust the Core Data PostgreSQL connection pool. Architecture: StateAggregatorService.getdevices() shares only its currently running observation task. The completed result is never cached; success and failure both clear the active task so the next request performs a fresh EdgeX read. Tech Stack: Python 3.11, asyncio, FastAPI, pytest ## Global Constraints - Physical device inventory, state, and telemetry authority remains EdgeX. - Do not cache the last successful device observation or present stale values as current. - Do not turn an EdgeX backend error into a successful empty inventory response. - Do not mutate EdgeX metadata/state, publish commands, or execute workflows. - Preserve unrelated working-tree changes and stage only the named files. --- ### Task 1: Concurrent device observation regression tests Files: - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testapi.py Interfaces: - Consumes: StateAggregatorService.getdevices() -> list[DeviceState] - Produces: regression coverage for concurrent sharing, no completed-result cache, and failure retry - [ ] Step 1: Add a failing concurrent sharing test Add after testdevicesendpointusesedgexinventoryandlatestevent: def test_device_observation_coalesces_concurrent_reads(monkeypatch, tmp_path): aggregator = StateAggregatorService(Settings(data_dir=tmp_path)) calls = {"inventory": 0, "latest": 0} async def scenario(): started = asyncio.Event() release = asyncio.Event() async def fake_devices(): calls["inventory"] += 1 started.set() await release.wait() return [_edgex_device("sensor-01")] async def fake_latest(device_name: str): calls["latest"] += 1 return [_reading(device_name, datetime.now(timezone.utc))] monkeypatch.setattr(aggregator.edgex, "get_devices", fake_devices) monkeypatch.setattr(aggregator.edgex, "get_latest_source_readings", fake_latest) tasks = [asyncio.create_task(aggregator.get_devices()) for _ in range(20)] await started.wait() await asyncio.sleep(0) assert calls["inventory"] == 1 release.set() results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks) return results results = asyncio.run(scenario()) assert calls == {"inventory": 1, "latest": 1} assert [[device.name for device in result] for result in results] == [ ["sensor-01"] ] * 20 - [ ] Step 2: Run the focused test and verify RED Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator ../../.venv-publisher/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_api.py::test_device_observation_coalesces_concurrent_reads Expected: FAIL because calls["inventory"] becomes greater than 1. - [ ] Step 3: Add no-cache and failure-retry regression tests def test_device_observation_does_not_cache_completed_result(monkeypatch, tmp_path): aggregator = StateAggregatorService(Settings(data_dir=tmp_path)) calls = 0 async def fake_devices(): nonlocal calls calls += 1 return [_edgex_device("sensor-01")] async def fake_latest(device_name: str): return [_reading(device_name, datetime.now(timezone.utc))] monkeypatch.setattr(aggregator.edgex, "get_devices", fake_devices) monkeypatch.setattr(aggregator.edgex, "get_latest_source_readings", fake_latest) async def scenario(): first = await aggregator.get_devices() second = await aggregator.get_devices() return first, second first, second = asyncio.run(scenario()) assert calls == 2 assert first[0].name == second[0].name == "sensor-01" def test_device_observation_failure_is_shared_and_next_call_retries(monkeypatch, tmp_path): aggregator = StateAggregatorService(Settings(data_dir=tmp_path)) calls = 0 async def scenario(): nonlocal calls started = asyncio.Event() release = asyncio.Event() async def fake_devices(): nonlocal calls calls += 1 if calls == 1: started.set() await release.wait() raise EdgeXBackendError("Core Data unavailable") return [_edgex_device("sensor-01")] async def fake_latest(device_name: str): return [_reading(device_name, datetime.now(timezone.utc))] monkeypatch.setattr(aggregator.edgex, "get_devices", fake_devices) monkeypatch.setattr(aggregator.edgex, "get_latest_source_readings", fake_latest) failed = [asyncio.create_task(aggregator.get_devices()) for _ in range(2)] await started.wait() await asyncio.sleep(0) release.set() failures = await asyncio.gather(*failed, return_exceptions=True) recovered = await aggregator.get_devices() return failures, recovered failures, recovered = asyncio.run(scenario()) assert calls == 2 assert all(isinstance(error, EdgeXBackendError) for error in failures) assert recovered[0].name == "sensor-01" - [ ] Step 4: Run all three focused tests and confirm only the sharing test is RED Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator ../../.venv-publisher/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_api.py -k 'device_observation_coalesces or device_observation_does_not_cache or device_observation_failure_is_shared' Expected: the concurrent sharing assertion fails before implementation; no-cache behavior already passes. ### Task 2: In-flight single-flight implementation Files: - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/service.py - Test: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testapi.py Interfaces: - Consumes: EdgeXClient.getdevices() and EdgeXClient.getlatestsourcereadings(devicename) - Produces: StateAggregatorService.getdevices() -> list[DeviceState] with in-flight sharing only - [ ] Step 1: Add the active observation task field In StateAggregatorService.init add: self._device_observation_task: asyncio.Task[list[DeviceState]] | None = None - [ ] Step 2: Split the backend read and share only an active task Replace getdevices with: async def get_devices(self) -> list[DeviceState]: task = self._device_observation_task if task is None or task.done(): task = asyncio.create_task(self._fetch_devices()) self._device_observation_task = task try: return list(await asyncio.shield(task)) finally: if task.done() and self._device_observation_task is task: self._device_observation_task = None async def _fetch_devices(self) -> list[DeviceState]: inventory = await self.edgex.get_devices() latest_events = await asyncio.gather( *(self.edgex.get_latest_source_readings(device.name) for device in inventory) ) return [ self._normalize_edgex_device(device, readings) for device, readings in zip(inventory, latest_events) ] - [ ] Step 3: Run the focused tests and verify GREEN Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator ../../.venv-publisher/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_api.py -k 'device_observation_coalesces or device_observation_does_not_cache or device_observation_failure_is_shared' Expected: 3 passed. - [ ] Step 4: Run the full state-aggregator regression suites Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator ../../.venv-publisher/bin/python -m pytest -q node --test tests/test_dashboard_source_isolation.js node --check app/static/dashboard.js Expected: all Python and JavaScript tests pass and syntax check exits 0. ### Task 3: Runtime recovery and burst verification Files: - Verify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/service.py - Verify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testapi.py Interfaces: - Consumes: the built state-aggregator image and live EdgeX Core Data service - Produces: evidence that concurrent dashboard reads no longer wedge Core Data Event APIs - [ ] Step 1: Build and deploy an amd64 state-aggregator image with a temporary Kaniko pod After the implementation commit, set a unique tag, create the temporary builder on server2, copy only the state-aggregator context, build and push, then make the Argo CD Application own that exact image override: STATE_AGG_TAG="singleflight-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" kubectl delete pod state-aggregator-kaniko-build -n default --ignore-not-found kubectl run state-aggregator-kaniko-build -n default \ --image=gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug \ --restart=Never \ --overrides='{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"kubernetes.io/hostname":"etri-ser0002-cgnmsb"}}}' \ --command -- /busybox/sh -c 'sleep 3600' kubectl wait -n default --for=condition=Ready pod/state-aggregator-kaniko-build --timeout=120s kubectl cp edge-orch/state-aggregator/. \ default/state-aggregator-kaniko-build:/workspace kubectl exec -n default state-aggregator-kaniko-build -- \ /kaniko/executor \ --context=dir:///workspace \ --dockerfile=/workspace/Dockerfile \ --destination="192.168.0.56:5000/state-aggregator:${STATE_AGG_TAG}" \ --insecure-registry=192.168.0.56:5000 kubectl patch application edge-orch-state-aggregator -n argocd --type=merge \ -p "{\"spec\":{\"source\":{\"kustomize\":{\"images\":[\"192.168.0.56:5000/state-aggregator:${STATE_AGG_TAG}\"]}}}}" kubectl annotate application edge-orch-state-aggregator -n argocd \ argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite kubectl rollout status deployment/state-aggregator -n default --timeout=180s kubectl delete pod state-aggregator-kaniko-build -n default --wait=true Expected: Kaniko pushes the unique amd64 image, Argo CD rolls out that image on etri-ser0001-cg0msb, and the temporary builder is removed. - [ ] Step 2: Restart the currently wedged Core Data deployment once Run: kubectl rollout restart deployment/edgex-core-data -n telemetry kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-core-data -n telemetry --timeout=120s Expected: rollout completes and the Event API returns 200. - [ ] Step 3: Send 30 concurrent dashboard requests Run the existing Python burst probe against http://192.168.0.56/aggregator/state/devices with 10 workers and 30 requests. Expected: all 30 responses are 200. - [ ] Step 4: Verify Core Data remains healthy after the burst Check /api/v3/ping, a device Event query, /state/devices, and PostgreSQL activity. Expected: ping and Event queries return 200, dashboard returns both registered devices, and Core Data connections are not permanently exhausted. - [ ] Step 5: Commit only the implementation and regression test git add edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/service.py edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/test_api.py git commit -m "fix: coalesce concurrent EdgeX device reads"

title: 엣지엑스 중앙 메시지버스와 엣지 디바이스 서비스 구현 계획
description: > For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-dri…
text: # 엣지엑스 중앙 메시지버스와 엣지 디바이스 서비스 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: Move the EdgeX Core, internal MessageBus, and PostgreSQL workloads from the Jetson to etri-ser0002-cgnmsb while retaining only protocol Device Services on the sensor edge nodes for the MQTT vertical slice. Architecture: The existing edgex/k8s Kustomize entry point remains authoritative. Core services, the internal Mosquitto MessageBus, and PostgreSQL run on server2 using amd64 EdgeX 4.0.2 images; the two ARM64 Device MQTT instances remain node-pinned to Jetson and Raspberry Pi and connect to the same central services through Kubernetes service DNS. SQLite replay and the alternate HTTPS ingest-gateway plane are not part of this slice. Tech Stack: Kubernetes/KubeEdge, Kustomize, Argo CD, EdgeX Foundry 4.0.2, Mosquitto 2.0.22, PostgreSQL 16.3, Python 3.12, pytest 8, PyYAML 6. ## Global Constraints - Every repository shell command starts with rtk. - The operational render entry point remains edgex/k8s and the namespace remains telemetry. - Central node: etri-ser0002-cgnmsb. - Jetson Device MQTT node: etri-dev0001-jetorn. - Sense HAT Device MQTT node: etri-dev0003-raspi5. - Central EdgeX images use version 4.0.2 without the -arm64 repository suffix. - Device MQTT images remain edgexfoundry/device-mqtt-arm64:4.0.2. - EdgeX internal MessageBus remains a ClusterIP service and is not a southbound device broker. - Existing unrelated working-tree changes are preserved. - Existing telemetry data does not require backup and service interruption is accepted. - Live deletion is limited to the exact telemetry namespace and occurs only after render and server-side dry-run succeed. --- ## File Structure edgex/k8s/ ├── core.yaml # central Keeper, config bootstrapper, Data, Metadata, Command ├── messagebus.yaml # central internal MQTT MessageBus ├── postgres.yaml # central EdgeX persistent database ├── device-mqtt.yaml # edge-only Device MQTT instances ├── kustomization.yaml # single operational render entry point ├── tests/ │ └── test_central_messagebus_topology.py └── scripts/ └── rebuild-central-messagebus.sh docs/ ├── 프로젝트-배경.md ├── 원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md ├── 프로젝트-범위.md ├── 저장소-구조.md └── ops/runbook-central-messagebus-rebuild.md ### Task 1: Lock the Direct MessageBus Placement Contract Files: - Create: edgex/k8s/tests/testcentralmessagebustopology.py - Read: edgex/k8s/kustomization.yaml Interfaces: - Consumes: rendered resources from kubectl kustomize edgex/k8s. - Produces: placement and architecture assertions used as the migration gate. - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing topology tests from __future__ import annotations import os import subprocess from pathlib import Path from typing import Any import yaml K8S_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] CENTRAL_NODE = "etri-ser0002-cgnmsb" EDGE_PLACEMENT = { "edgex-device-mqtt": "etri-dev0001-jetorn", "edgex-device-mqtt-sensehat": "etri-dev0003-raspi5", } CENTRAL_WORKLOADS = { "edgex-core-keeper", "edgex-core-common-config-bootstrapper", "edgex-core-data", "edgex-core-metadata", "edgex-core-command", "edgex-messagebus", "edgex-postgres", } def render() -> list[dict[str, Any]]: result = subprocess.run( [os.environ.get("KUBECTL", "kubectl"), "kustomize", str(K8S_DIR)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, ) return [item for item in yaml.safe_load_all(result.stdout) if item] def pod_spec(resource: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]: return resource["spec"]["template"]["spec"] def workloads() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]: return { resource["metadata"]["name"]: resource for resource in render() if resource["kind"] in {"Deployment", "StatefulSet", "Job"} } def test_central_workloads_run_only_on_server2() -> None: rendered = workloads() assert CENTRAL_WORKLOADS <= rendered.keys() for name in CENTRAL_WORKLOADS: assert pod_spec(rendered[name])["nodeSelector"] == { "kubernetes.io/hostname": CENTRAL_NODE } def test_device_services_remain_on_the_sensor_edges() -> None: rendered = workloads() for name, node in EDGE_PLACEMENT.items(): assert pod_spec(rendered[name])["nodeSelector"] == { "kubernetes.io/hostname": node } def test_core_images_are_amd64_and_device_images_are_arm64() -> None: rendered = workloads() for name in CENTRAL_WORKLOADS: containers = [ *pod_spec(rendered[name]).get("initContainers", []), *pod_spec(rendered[name]).get("containers", []), ] for container in containers: image = container["image"] if "edgexfoundry/" in image: assert ":4.0.2" in image assert "-arm64" not in image for name in EDGE_PLACEMENT: assert pod_spec(rendered[name])["containers"][0]["image"] == ( "edgexfoundry/device-mqtt-arm64:4.0.2" ) def test_edge_has_no_local_core_messagebus_or_database() -> None: rendered = workloads() edge_nodes = set(EDGE_PLACEMENT.values()) for name, resource in rendered.items(): node = pod_spec(resource).get("nodeSelector", {}).get("kubernetes.io/hostname") if node in edge_nodes: assert name in EDGE_PLACEMENT def test_internal_messagebus_is_cluster_only() -> None: service = next( item for item in render() if item["kind"] == "Service" and item["metadata"]["name"] == "edgex-messagebus" ) assert service["spec"]["type"] == "ClusterIP" assert service["spec"]["ports"] == [{"name": "mqtt", "port": 1883, "targetPort": "mqtt"}] def test_device_services_use_the_central_configuration_and_registry() -> None: rendered = workloads() for name in EDGE_PLACEMENT: args = pod_spec(rendered[name])["containers"][0]["args"] assert "-cp=keeper.http://edgex-core-keeper:59890" in args assert "--registry" in args - [ ] Step 2: Run the test and verify old Jetson placement fails Run: rtk python3 -m pytest edgex/k8s/tests/test_central_messagebus_topology.py -q Expected: placement and image tests fail because Core, MessageBus, and PostgreSQL still target etri-dev0001-jetorn and use ARM64 images. - [ ] Step 3: Commit the failing contract rtk git add edgex/k8s/tests/test_central_messagebus_topology.py rtk git commit -m "test: define central EdgeX placement contract" ### Task 2: Move the Core Data Plane to server2 Files: - Modify: edgex/k8s/core.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/messagebus.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/postgres.yaml - Verify: edgex/k8s/device-mqtt.yaml Interfaces: - Consumes: existing telemetry namespace service names and the Task 1 topology contract. - Produces: one central EdgeX Core/MessageBus/PostgreSQL stack with edge-only Device MQTT workloads. - [ ] Step 1: Change every Core workload node selector In edgex/k8s/core.yaml, replace every Core workload selector value: nodeSelector: kubernetes.io/hostname: etri-ser0002-cgnmsb This applies to Keeper, core-common-config-bootstrapper, Core Data, Core Metadata, and Core Command. - [ ] Step 2: Change Core EdgeX images to amd64 repositories Use exactly these images: edgexfoundry/core-keeper:4.0.2 edgexfoundry/core-common-config-bootstrapper:4.0.2 edgexfoundry/core-data:4.0.2 edgexfoundry/core-metadata:4.0.2 edgexfoundry/core-command:4.0.2 - [ ] Step 3: Move MessageBus and PostgreSQL to server2 In edgex/k8s/messagebus.yaml and edgex/k8s/postgres.yaml, set: nodeSelector: kubernetes.io/hostname: etri-ser0002-cgnmsb Keep edgex-messagebus as type: ClusterIP and do not add a host port or local edge broker. - [ ] Step 4: Run the topology tests Run: rtk python3 -m pytest edgex/k8s/tests/test_central_messagebus_topology.py -q Expected: 6 passed. - [ ] Step 5: Run existing manifest tests to discover incompatible legacy assertions Run: rtk python3 -m pytest edgex/k8s/tests -q Expected: the new topology test passes. Any failures that only assert the alternate HTTPS gateway/edge-agent topology are recorded as legacy-test conflicts and are not satisfied by reintroducing that data path. - [ ] Step 6: Commit central placement changes rtk git add edgex/k8s/core.yaml edgex/k8s/messagebus.yaml edgex/k8s/postgres.yaml rtk git commit -m "feat: centralize EdgeX core data plane" ### Task 3: Align Active Documentation and Mark the HTTPS Plane Inactive Files: - Modify: docs/프로젝트-배경.md - Modify: docs/프로젝트-범위.md - Modify: docs/저장소-구조.md - Modify: docs/원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md - Create: docs/ops/runbook-central-messagebus-rebuild.md Interfaces: - Consumes: the rendered topology from Task 2. - Produces: one current architecture description and an exact destructive rebuild procedure. - [ ] Step 1: Replace the active telemetry flow in the four scope documents Use this canonical flow verbatim: physical sensor / PLC / equipment -> EdgeX Device Service on Jetson or Raspberry Pi -> central EdgeX MessageBus on etri-ser0002-cgnmsb -> Core Data -> PostgreSQL -> Application Service / AI consumer / state-aggregator / dashboard State explicitly that edgex/telemetry-plane, edgex-ingest-gateway, and edge-telemetry-agent are inactive design/prototype artifacts and are not deployed by edgex/k8s/kustomization.yaml. - [ ] Step 2: Document the phase-one failure behavior Add these exact constraints: - Phase one has no SQLite durable replay. - Central MessageBus/network failure may lose telemetry. - Recovery acceptance is new Event ingestion after connectivity returns. - SQLite replay requires a separate approved design and implementation. - [ ] Step 3: Write the rebuild runbook The runbook must contain these ordered commands and state that the delete target is exactly namespace telemetry: rtk kubectl get nodes -o wide rtk kubectl kustomize edgex/k8s >/tmp/edgex-central-messagebus.yaml rtk kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f /tmp/edgex-central-messagebus.yaml rtk kubectl get all,pvc,configmap,secret -n telemetry rtk kubectl delete namespace telemetry --wait=true --timeout=300s rtk kubectl apply -k edgex/k8s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-core-keeper -n telemetry --timeout=300s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-core-data -n telemetry --timeout=300s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-core-metadata -n telemetry --timeout=300s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-core-command -n telemetry --timeout=300s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-messagebus -n telemetry --timeout=300s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-device-mqtt -n telemetry --timeout=300s rtk kubectl rollout status deployment/edgex-device-mqtt-sensehat -n telemetry --timeout=300s - [ ] Step 4: Scan active docs for conflicting current paths Run: rtk rg -n "edge-telemetry-agent|edgex-ingest-gateway|HTTPS POST /v1/events" docs --glob '!docs/archive/**' --glob '!docs/superpowers/**' Expected: matches only identify those paths as inactive/prototype or historical evidence. - [ ] Step 5: Commit documentation rtk git add docs/프로젝트-배경.md docs/프로젝트-범위.md docs/저장소-구조.md docs/원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md docs/ops/runbook-central-messagebus-rebuild.md rtk git commit -m "docs: align EdgeX central message bus operations" ### Task 4: Add a Guarded Rebuild Helper Files: - Create: edgex/k8s/scripts/rebuild-central-messagebus.sh - Create: edgex/k8s/tests/testrebuildcentralmessagebus.py Interfaces: - Consumes: a working kubectl context and edgex/k8s render. - Produces: a no-op preflight by default and an exact namespace rebuild only with --execute. - [ ] Step 1: Write failing script-safety tests from pathlib import Path SCRIPT = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "scripts" / "rebuild-central-messagebus.sh" def test_rebuild_requires_explicit_execute_flag() -> None: text = SCRIPT.read_text() assert 'if [[ "${1:-}" != "--execute" ]]' in text assert "kubectl delete namespace telemetry" in text assert "kubectl apply --dry-run=server" in text assert text.index("kubectl apply --dry-run=server") < text.index( "kubectl delete namespace telemetry" ) def test_rebuild_validates_exact_nodes_before_delete() -> None: text = SCRIPT.read_text() for node in ( "etri-ser0002-cgnmsb", "etri-dev0001-jetorn", "etri-dev0003-raspi5", ): assert f"kubectl get node {node}" in text - [ ] Step 2: Run the tests and confirm the script is missing Run: rtk python3 -m pytest edgex/k

title: 기존 엣지 Agent 퇴역 구현 계획
description: > For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-dri…
text: # 기존 엣지 Agent 퇴역 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: 개발 단계의 edgex-edge-agent-jetson과 edgex-edge-agent-sensehat, 두 SQLite outbox PVC와 Agent 전용 Metadata bootstrap을 Git/Argo CD/live cluster에서 제거하고, 중앙 EdgeX와 EdgeMesh를 그대로 보존한다. Architecture: root Kustomize 진입점에서 기존 sensor-gateways overlay를 제거하고 edgex-edge Namespace와 기본 deny 정책만 가진 중립 base로 교체한다. 이후 정식 EdgeX Device Service가 들어올 자리를 남기되, 아직 구현되지 않은 Device Service나 telemetry를 현재 기능으로 주장하지 않는다. Argo CD는 자동 prune/self-heal이므로 Git 커밋을 먼저 push한 뒤 Application의 고정 revision을 새 커밋으로 전환한다. Tech Stack: Kubernetes, Kustomize, Argo CD, Python/pytest, Git/GitHub, EdgeX 4.0.2 ## 고정 경계 - edgex-system의 Core Keeper, Core Metadata, Core Data, Core Command, MessageBus, PostgreSQL, ingest gateway는 변경하지 않는다. - EdgeMesh 리소스와 설정은 조회·수정·재시작하지 않는다. - 고정 ClusterIP, PodIP, node IP를 추가하지 않는다. - edgex-edge Namespace는 다음 Device Service 배포를 위해 유지한다. - Agent Deployment와 전용 PVC는 삭제한다. 사용자가 개발 데이터 유실과 일시 중단을 승인했다. - Agent 이름이 붙은 기존 Secret과 중앙 gateway 인증 계약은 이번 퇴역에서 회전·삭제하지 않는다. 정식 Device Service 전환 시 인증 경로와 함께 별도 정리한다. - edgex/telemetry-plane의 중앙 gateway 코드는 유지한다. edge Agent 실행 경로만 운영 render에서 제거한다. - 혼합 작업 트리의 기존 변경은 stage하지 않는다. --- ### Task 1: Agent가 없는 운영 render 계약을 테스트로 고정 Files: - Modify: edgex/k8s/tests/testmanifests.py - Modify: edgex/k8s/tests/testcentralmessagebustopology.py Interfaces: - Root render must contain: 중앙 EdgeX workload와 Namespace/edgex-edge - Root render must not contain: edgex-edge-agent-, Agent PVC/ConfigMap/NetworkPolicy - Central MessageBus remains: Service/edgex-messagebus type ClusterIP - [ ] Step 1: 실패 테스트 작성 testmanifests.py에서 edge fixture를 새 base/edge-namespace 경로로 바꾸고 다음 계약을 추가한다. RETIRED_EDGE_AGENTS = { "edgex-edge-agent-jetson", "edgex-edge-agent-sensehat", } assert kustomization["resources"] == [ "overlays/testbed/server2", "base/edge-namespace", ] assert not RETIRED_EDGE_AGENTS & workload_names assert not { name for kind, name in indexed if kind == "PersistentVolumeClaim" and name.startswith("edgex-edge-agent-") } testcentralmessagebustopology.py에서는 두 Agent의 node placement/image/direct-mode 테스트를 제거하고 root render에 퇴역 이름이 없음을 검증한다. - [ ] Step 2: RED 확인 Run: rtk /home/jinuk/codex-work/jinuk/edgex/telemetry-plane/.venv/bin/pytest \ edgex/k8s/tests/test_manifests.py \ edgex/k8s/tests/test_central_messagebus_topology.py -q Expected: 현재 root가 sensor-gateways를 선택하고 두 Agent를 렌더하므로 assertion failure. ### Task 2: Agent manifest와 PVC를 운영 진입점에서 제거 Files: - Create: edgex/k8s/base/edge-namespace/kustomization.yaml - Create: edgex/k8s/base/edge-namespace/common.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/kustomization.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/base/edge-agent/kustomization.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/base/edge-agent/common.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/overlays/testbed/sensor-gateways/kustomization.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/overlays/testbed/sensor-gateways/jetson.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/overlays/testbed/sensor-gateways/sensehat.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/base/server/kustomization.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/base/server/gateway.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/base/server/metadata.yaml - Delete: edgex/k8s/base/server/config/metadata-contract.json Interfaces: - base/edge-namespace produces only Namespace/edgex-edge and NetworkPolicy/edgex-edge-default-deny. - Root render no longer produces edge workload, Agent ConfigMap, Agent egress/ingress policy, outbox PVC, Agent Metadata contract or bootstrap Job. - [ ] Step 1: 최소 manifest 구현 apiVersion: v1 kind: Namespace metadata: name: edgex-edge --- apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1 kind: NetworkPolicy metadata: name: edgex-edge-default-deny spec: podSelector: {} policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress] Root resources는 다음 두 경로만 사용한다. resources: - overlays/testbed/server2 - base/edge-namespace - [ ] Step 2: GREEN 확인 Run: rtk /home/jinuk/codex-work/jinuk/edgex/telemetry-plane/.venv/bin/pytest \ edgex/k8s/tests/test_manifests.py \ edgex/k8s/tests/test_central_messagebus_topology.py -q rtk kubectl kustomize edgex/k8s > /tmp/edgex-retired-render.yaml rtk rg -n 'edgex-edge-agent|sensor-gateways' /tmp/edgex-retired-render.yaml Expected: pytest passes; final rg exits 1 with no matches. ### Task 3: 현재 문서와 설계 이력 경계 최신화 Files: - Modify: AGENTS.md - Modify: docs/저장소-구조.md - Modify: docs/현재-데모-경로.md - Modify: docs/원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md - Modify: docs/디바이스-서비스-연결.md - Modify: docs/ops/현재-데모-운영-절차.md - Modify: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-21-가상디바이스-런타임-중앙-엣지엑스-설계.md - Modify: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-21-젯슨-엣지-텔레메트리-에이전트-구현-계획.md - Regenerate: docs/html/ through scripts/build-docs-html.py Documentation contract: - 현재: 중앙 EdgeX는 유지되고 edgex-edge에는 수집 workload가 의도적으로 없다. - 다음 구현: Jetson의 Arduino 센서 1종을 정식 EdgeX Device Service/Profile/Device로 연결한다. - 과거 Agent 문서: 설계 이력/퇴역 상태이며 재배포 절차가 아니다. - 가상디바이스 Runtime: 별도 Agent가 아니라 custom EdgeX Device Service 형태로 재정렬하기 전까지 후속 설계 이력이다. - [ ] Step 1: source 문서 갱신 현재형 Agent 설명을 퇴역 상태로 바꾸고, telemetry가 잠시 중단된 개발 전환 상태임을 명시한다. 중앙 EdgeX가 계속 Running이라는 사실과 Device Service 미배포 상태를 구분한다. - [ ] Step 2: HTML 재생성 및 문서 검증 rtk python3 scripts/build-docs-html.py rtk python3 -m unittest tests.test_docs_html_search rtk rg -n --glob '!docs/archive/**' --glob '!docs/html/**' \ '현재 root render.*edge-agent|현재 배포.*edgex-edge-agent' docs Expected: generator와 unittest 통과; 현재형 Agent 배포 주장이 남지 않음. 설계 이력의 이름 언급은 허용한다. ### Task 4: 검증, 선택 stage, commit, push Files: 이번 계획에 명시한 파일만 stage한다. - [ ] Step 1: 전체 관련 검증 rtk /home/jinuk/codex-work/jinuk/edgex/telemetry-plane/.venv/bin/pytest edgex/k8s/tests -q rtk kubectl kustomize edgex/k8s > /tmp/edgex-retired-render.yaml rtk git diff --check rtk git status --short - [ ] Step 2: 의도한 파일만 stage하고 diff 검토 rtk git add \ AGENTS.md \ edgex/k8s/kustomization.yaml \ edgex/k8s/base/edge-namespace \ edgex/k8s/base/edge-agent \ edgex/k8s/base/server/kustomization.yaml \ edgex/k8s/base/server/gateway.yaml \ edgex/k8s/base/server/metadata.yaml \ edgex/k8s/base/server/config/metadata-contract.json \ edgex/k8s/overlays/testbed/sensor-gateways \ edgex/k8s/tests/test_manifests.py \ edgex/k8s/tests/test_central_messagebus_topology.py \ docs/저장소-구조.md \ docs/현재-데모-경로.md \ docs/원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md \ docs/디바이스-서비스-연결.md \ docs/ops/현재-데모-운영-절차.md \ docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-21-가상디바이스-런타임-중앙-엣지엑스-설계.md \ docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-21-젯슨-엣지-텔레메트리-에이전트-구현-계획.md \ docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-21-기존-엣지-에이전트-퇴역-구현-계획.md rtk git diff --cached --check rtk git diff --cached --stat 생성 HTML은 generator가 만든 이번 source 대응 파일과 index 변경만 별도로 확인해 stage한다. - [ ] Step 3: commit과 push rtk git commit -m "refactor: retire custom edge telemetry agents" rtk git push -u origin agent/retire-edge-agents ### Task 5: Argo CD revision 전환과 live prune 검증 Files: live cluster only; Git 파일 추가 변경 없음. - [ ] Step 1: push된 커밋과 현재 Application 대상을 확인 rtk git rev-parse HEAD rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/agent/retire-edge-agents rtk kubectl -n argocd get application edgex-telemetry \ -o jsonpath='{.spec.source.targetRevision}{"\\n"}{.status.sync.status}{"\\n"}' - [ ] Step 2: Application을 push된 immutable commit SHA로 전환 정확한 HEAD를 확인한 뒤 spec.source.targetRevision만 patch한다. EdgeMesh 리소스는 건드리지 않는다. - [ ] Step 3: prune 완료 확인 rtk kubectl -n argocd wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.sync.status}'=Synced \ application/edgex-telemetry --timeout=180s rtk kubectl -n edgex-edge get deployment,pvc,configmap,networkpolicy rtk kubectl -n edgex-system get pod -o wide Expected: - edgex-edge-agent-jetson, edgex-edge-agent-sensehat 없음 - 두 Agent outbox PVC 없음 - edgex-edge-default-deny와 Namespace는 유지 - 중앙 EdgeX Pod는 기존 노드 etri-ser0002-cgnmsb에서 Ready/Completed 상태 유지 - [ ] Step 4: Agent 전용 Metadata 객체를 정확한 이름으로 제거 Core Metadata에서 참조 관계를 먼저 조회한 뒤 sensehat-001 Device, etri-sensehat Device Profile, edge-telemetry-agent Device Service 순서로만 삭제한다. 다른 Device/Profile/Service는 삭제하지 않는다. 삭제 뒤 세 name 조회가 not found이고 중앙 ping이 정상인지 확인한다. ### Task 6: 다음 구현 착수 조건 - [ ] Jetson /dev/ttyACM 실제 endpoint와 Arduino line protocol을 read-only 확인한다. - [ ] 서비스 데모 1종의 EdgeX Device Profile/Device 이름과 resource를 고정한다. - [ ] 공식 EdgeX Device SDK 기반 custom Serial Device Service 구현 계획을 TDD로 작성한다. - [ ] Device Service가 실제 Event/Reading을 Core Data에 남기고 dashboard가 freshness를 표시하는 종단간 증거를 완료 기준으로 사용한다.

title: Raspberry Pi Sense HAT I2C Device Service 구현 계획
description: > 실행 방식: 테스트를 먼저 실패시키고 최소 구현으로 통과시킨 뒤, ARM64 image와 > live EdgeX readba…
text: # Raspberry Pi Sense HAT I2C Device Service 구현 계획 실행 방식: 테스트를 먼저 실패시키고 최소 구현으로 통과시킨 뒤, ARM64 image와 live EdgeX readback까지 단계별로 검증한다. Goal: etri-dev0003-raspi5의 Sense HAT v1을 MQTT 없이 직접 읽는 EdgeX Device Service를 배포하고 6개 가상 Device를 중앙/로컬 API와 dashboard에서 확인한다. Architecture: image 내부 RTIMULib Python reader가 /dev/i2c-1을 한 번 읽어 JSON sample을 만들고 Go EdgeX Device SDK driver가 6개 Device Event, Command와 bounded recent cache로 fan-out한다. 중앙 EdgeX와 EdgeMesh는 유지한다. Tech Stack: Go 1.25, EdgeX Device SDK Go v4.0.2, Python 3/RTIMULib 7.2.1, Kustomize, Argo CD, Docker buildx, ko, pytest/unittest. --- ## Task 1: RTIMULib protocol reader Files: - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/reader/readsensehat.py - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/reader/testreadsensehat.py - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/reader/RTIMULib.ini 1. degree normalization, validity flag, finite-value와 11-field sample 계약 테스트를 먼저 작성하고 RED를 확인한다. 2. fake RTIMU object로 pressure/humidity/IMU 성공과 invalid read 오류를 테스트한다. 3. shell/network/MQTT 없이 JSON line 하나를 생성하는 reader를 구현한다. 4. retry는 Go layer가 소유하므로 Python fatal read는 non-zero exit로 단순화한다. ## Task 2: Go parser와 managed process source Files: - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/go.mod - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/sample.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/sampletest.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/source.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/sourcetest.go 1. strict JSON, device ID, required finite Float64 field 테스트를 RED로 만든다. 2. command factory를 주입할 수 있는 source test double로 process exit, state UP/DOWN, backoff와 context stop을 검증한다. 3. scanner limit, stderr drain, shell 미사용과 child cleanup을 구현한다. ## Task 3: I2C binding, recent cache와 Local Data API Files: - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/config.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/configtest.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/recentcache.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/recentcachetest.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/localdataapi.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/localdataapitest.go 1. /dev/i2c-1, sensehat-001과 6개 ResourceGroup만 허용하는 binding 테스트를 작성한다. 2. Float64 cache의 10분·10,000개 eviction, device/resource 격리, newest limit, 동시 접근을 테스트한다. 3. Jetson과 같은 latest/recent HTTP status/query/정렬 계약을 테스트한다. ## Task 4: EdgeX Device SDK driver Files: - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/cmd/device-sensehat/main.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/driver.go - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/drivertest.go 1. 한 sample의 6개 Device fan-out과 group별 resource 수/단위/type/origin을 테스트한다. 2. multi-resource Core Command GET, write 거부, LOCKED/remove/cache cleanup, 동일 update no-op, shared source 한 개와 state fan-out을 테스트한다. 3. Device SDK custom route와 async channel 통합을 구현한다. ## Task 5: Profile/Device/config resources Files: - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/res/configuration.yaml - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/res/profiles/etri-sensehat-.yaml (6개) - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/res/devices/sensehat-virtual-devices.yaml - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/internal/driver/resourcestest.go 1. 6개 Device/Profile 이름, Float64/resource/units/command와 공통 I2C binding 테스트를 RED로 작성한다. 2. canonical resources를 구현하고 aggregate sensehat-001 Device를 만들지 않는다. ## Task 6: ARM64 runtime와 Kubernetes manifest Files: - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/Dockerfile.base - Create: edgex/device-sensehat/.ko.yaml - Create: edgex/k8s/base/device-sensehat-raspi/ - Modify: edgex/k8s/kustomization.yaml - Create: edgex/k8s/tests/testdevicesensehatmanifest.py - Modify: edgex/k8s/tests/testdeviceserialmanifest.py 1. root render에 Serial/I2C 두 edge workload만 있고 MQTT Agent/InfluxDB/PVC가 없다는 manifest 테스트를 먼저 실패시킨다. 2. exact Raspberry Pi placement, /dev/i2c-1 CharDevice, Recreate, FQDN, port 59911, read-only root와 /tmp, 정책 의도 label을 테스트한다. 3. canonical resource와 ConfigMap byte equality를 테스트한다. 4. RTIMULib ARM64 base image를 build/push하고 digest로 .ko.yaml을 고정한다. 5. Go service image를 build/push하고 workload image를 digest로 고정한다. ## Task 7: Argo live cutover와 회귀 1. 구현 commit을 원격 branch에 push하고 edgex-telemetry targetRevision을 해당 SHA로 동기화한다. 2. device-sensehat-raspi가 etri-dev0003-raspi5에서 기대 digest, Ready, restart 0인지 확인한다. 3. Metadata 6개, Core Data latest 6개, Core Command 6개, Local Data API와 dashboard 12개 inventory/freshness를 readback한다. 4. Jetson Serial 6개가 계속 fresh이고 local cache/command가 회귀하지 않았는지 확인한다. 5. legacy MQTT publisher의 최근 publish가 없고 새 Pod가 local MQTT port를 사용하지 않음을 확인한다. 6. EdgeMesh generation 14, image v1.17.0, 5/5 Ready가 유지되는지 확인한다. ## Task 8: protocol matrix와 문서/최종 검증 Files: - Update: docs/문서-안내.md, docs/프로젝트-범위.md, docs/프로젝트-배경.md - Update: docs/원시-텔레메트리-데이터-플레인.md, docs/디바이스-서비스-연결.md - Update: docs/현재-데모-경로.md, docs/ops/현재-데모-운영-절차.md - Update: docs/wiki/.md, docs/일일-기록.md, docs/wiki/변경-기록.md - Regenerate: docs/html/, docs/generated/consistency-report.html 1. Serial/I2C는 live PASS, MQTT physical input은 미사용, Modbus/OPC-UA는 endpoint 부재로 미검증이라고 명시한다. 2. 기존 Sense HAT MQTT/KubeEdge fixture를 현재 경로로 설명하지 않는다. 3. Python/Go race/vet, EdgeX K8s, state-aggregator, docs test와 root render를 모두 실행한다. 4. live resource, 임시 Pod 부재, fixed IP/PVC/Agent/InfluxDB 부재와 EdgeMesh 무변경을 다시 확인한다. 5. git diff --check, clean worktree와 remote HEAD 일치를 확인한 뒤 최종 push한다.

title: 아두이노 6개 가상 디바이스와 InfluxDB 제거 구현 계획
description: > For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-dri…
text: # 아두이노 6개 가상 디바이스와 InfluxDB 제거 구현 계획 For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking. Goal: Jetson의 Arduino 시리얼 포트를 한 번만 읽어 여섯 EdgeX 가상 디바이스로 Event를 분리하고, 활성 배포와 state-aggregator에서 InfluxDB를 완전히 제거한다. Architecture: device-serial-jetson은 (Port, BaudRate, DeviceID)별 공유 connection 하나와 ResourceName -> EdgeX DeviceName route를 관리한다. EdgeX Core Metadata에는 1-resource Profile/Device 여섯 개만 등록하며, telemetry 저장과 조회는 Core Data/PostgreSQL로 단일화한다. Tech Stack: Go 1.23, EdgeX Device SDK Go v4, YAML/Kustomize, Python 3/FastAPI/pytest, Argo CD, Kubernetes, Harbor ## Global Constraints - EdgeMesh 리소스와 설정은 변경하지 않는다. - 고정 ClusterIP, PodIP 또는 node IP를 사용하지 않고 Kubernetes service FQDN만 사용한다. - 중앙 EdgeX Core Service, MessageBus와 PostgreSQL은 유지한다. - MQTT broker, edge agent, SQLite outbox를 추가하지 않는다. - 물리 source ID는 arduino-001, EdgeX inventory는 정확히 여섯 가상 Device다. - Jetson node selector는 etri-dev0001-jetorn을 유지한다. - root 운영 배포 진입점은 edgex/k8s다. --- ### Task 1: 공유 시리얼 connection과 6-way fan-out Files: - Modify: edgex/device-serial/internal/driver/config.go - Modify: edgex/device-serial/internal/driver/configtest.go - Modify: edgex/device-serial/internal/driver/driver.go - Modify: edgex/device-serial/internal/driver/drivertest.go Interfaces: - Consumes: ParseLine(line []byte, expectedDevice string) (Sample, error)과 ReaderOptions - Produces: SerialConfig.ResourceName string, SerialConfig.key() connectionKey, 공유 managedConnection, resource별 AsyncValues - [ ] Step 1: config와 fan-out 실패 테스트 작성 configtest.go에서 ResourceName이 필수이고 지원 resource만 허용됨을 고정한다. drivertest.go에는 다음 행위를 고정한다. func TestDriverSharesOneReaderAndFansOutAcceleration(t *testing.T) { // virtual-acceleration-x/y/z-001을 동일 physical protocol로 AddDevice한다. // factory.count() == 1을 확인한다. // acceleration sample 하나를 OnSample로 전달한다. // 세 AsyncValues의 DeviceName/resource/sourceName이 각각 x/y/z인지 확인한다. } func TestDriverFansOutConnectionStateAndClosesAfterLastRoute(t *testing.T) { // temperature/light 두 Device를 추가하고 UP이 양쪽 SDK state update로 전달되는지 확인한다. // 첫 Device 제거 후 reader가 열려 있고, 마지막 Device 제거 후 닫히는지 확인한다. } func TestDriverRejectsDuplicateResourceBinding(t *testing.T) { // 동일 connection/resource에 두 Device를 연결하면 duplicate route 오류인지 확인한다. } - [ ] Step 2: RED 확인 Run: cd edgex/device-serial && go test ./internal/driver -run 'Test(ParseSerialConfig|Driver)' -count=1 Expected: ResourceName 필드/공유 route 동작이 없어 compile failure 또는 reader count/event identity assertion failure. - [ ] Step 3: 최소 공유 connection 구현 SerialConfig에 route를 추가하고 connection identity를 분리한다. type SerialConfig struct { Port string BaudRate int DeviceID string ResourceName string } type connectionKey struct { port string baudRate int deviceID string } func (config SerialConfig) key() connectionKey { return connectionKey{config.Port, config.BaudRate, config.DeviceID} } Driver는 다음 책임으로 교체한다. type managedConnection struct { reader managedReader cancel context.CancelFunc config SerialConfig routes map[string]string state models.OperatingState hasState bool } type deviceBinding struct { config SerialConfig connection *managedConnection } - connections map[connectionKey]managedConnection - bindings map[string]deviceBinding - connection 최초 route에서만 reader 생성 - sample Reading마다 route Device를 찾아 1-reading Event 생성 - temperatureraw -> temperature, accelerationxraw -> accelerationx source map 사용 - connection state를 현재 route Device 전체에 반영 - 마지막 route 제거 시 reader cancel/close - [ ] Step 4: GREEN 및 race 확인 Run: cd edgex/device-serial && go test -race ./... -count=1 Expected: all Go tests pass, race detector reports no race. - [ ] Step 5: 커밋 git add edgex/device-serial/internal/driver git commit -m "feat: fan out serial readings to virtual devices" ### Task 2: 여섯 EdgeX Profile/Device와 Kustomize mount Files: - Delete: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-serial.yaml - Delete: edgex/device-serial/res/devices/arduino-001.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-temperature.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-light.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-magnetic.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-acceleration-x.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-acceleration-y.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/profiles/etri-arduino-acceleration-z.yaml - Create: edgex/device-serial/res/devices/arduino-virtual-devices.yaml - Modify: edgex/device-serial/internal/driver/resourcestest.go - Mirror: edgex/k8s/base/device-serial-jetson/config/ - Modify: edgex/k8s/base/device-serial-jetson/kustomization.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/base/device-serial-jetson/workload.yaml - Modify: edgex/k8s/tests/testdeviceserialmanifest.py - Modify: edgex/k8s/tests/testmanifests.py Interfaces: - Consumes: Task 1의 ResourceName protocol property - Produces: 정확히 여섯 deviceList entry와 각 1-resource Profile - [ ] Step 1: resource/manifest 실패 테스트 작성 resourcestest.go는 다음 table을 순회한다. var virtualDevices = []struct{ name, profile, resource string }{ {"virtual-temperature-001", "etri-arduino-temperature", "temperature_raw"}, {"virtual-light-001", "etri-arduino-light", "light_raw"}, {"virtual-magnetic-001", "etri-arduino-magnetic", "magnetic_raw"}, {"virtual-acceleration-x-001", "etri-arduino-acceleration-x", "acceleration_x_raw"}, {"virtual-acceleration-y-001", "etri-arduino-acceleration-y", "acceleration_y_raw"}, {"virtual-acceleration-z-001", "etri-arduino-acceleration-z", "acceleration_z_raw"}, } Python manifest test는 ConfigMap key와 /res/profiles, /res/devices mount가 위 일곱 YAML 파일만 포함하고 aggregate 파일을 포함하지 않음을 확인한다. - [ ] Step 2: RED 확인 Run: cd edgex/device-serial && go test ./internal/driver -run TestDeviceResources -count=1 Run: python3 -m pytest edgex/k8s/tests/testdeviceserialmanifest.py edgex/k8s/tests/testmanifests.py -q Expected: 새 YAML 파일과 여섯 Device가 없어서 failure. - [ ] Step 3: Profile/Device와 Kustomize 구현 각 Profile은 다음 구조의 resource 하나와 read command 하나만 가진다. apiVersion: "v2" name: etri-arduino-temperature deviceResources: - name: temperature_raw properties: {valueType: Int32, readWrite: R, units: raw} deviceCommands: - name: temperature readWrite: R resourceOperations: - deviceResource: temperature_raw 각 Device protocol에는 동일 Port/BaudRate/DeviceID와 고유 ResourceName을 넣고 tag에는 물리 ID와 node name을 넣는다. Kustomize generator와 Deployment ConfigMap items를 새 파일 목록으로 교체한다. - [ ] Step 4: GREEN 및 root render 확인 Run: cd edgex/device-serial && go test ./... -count=1 Run: python3 -m pytest edgex/k8s/tests -q Run: kubectl kustomize edgex/k8s >/dev/null Expected: all commands exit 0. - [ ] Step 5: 커밋 git add edgex/device-serial edgex/k8s/base/device-serial-jetson edgex/k8s/tests git commit -m "feat: provision six Arduino virtual devices" ### Task 3: state-aggregator와 manifest에서 InfluxDB 제거 Files: - Delete: influxdb/influxdb.yaml - Delete: influxdb/influxdb-connectivity-test.yaml - Delete: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/influx.py - Delete: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/placementrecorder.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/config.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/service.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/main.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/app/static/workflow-render-panels.js - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/k8s/deployment.yaml - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/k8s/README.md - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testapi.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testdashboardresilience.py - Modify: edge-orch/state-aggregator/tests/testresourceprofile.py Interfaces: - Consumes: Prometheus resource usage와 EdgeX Core Data telemetry history - Produces: recorder metadata가 없는 read-only resource profile API - [ ] Step 1: 제거 계약 테스트부터 수정 테스트는 Settings에 influxdb와 resourceprofilerecording가 없고 resource profile 응답 key가 다음 집합임을 확인한다. assert set(profile_payload) == { "generated_at", "profile_scope", "summary", "service_resource_profiles", } assert not hasattr(Settings(), "influxdb_url") POST /state/service-resource-profiles/record는 404를 기대하고 UI fixture는 EdgeX Core Data / PostgreSQL을 기대한다. - [ ] Step 2: RED 확인 Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator && python3 -m pytest tests/testapi.py tests/testdashboardresilience.py tests/testresourceprofile.py -q Expected: 기존 recording key, endpoint, Settings와 recorder test 때문에 failure. - main의 degraded resource state와 filtered endpoint도 같은 계약을 사용한다. - record POST endpoint를 삭제한다. - UI sink 기본값을 EdgeX Core Data / PostgreSQL로 바꾼다. - Deployment env와 root influxdb/ 파일을 삭제한다. - [ ] Step 4: GREEN 및 잔존 참조 검사 Run: cd edge-orch/state-aggregator && python3 -m pytest -q Run: rg -n -i 'influx|recordingbackend|RESOURCEPROFILERECORDINGMODE' edge-orch/state-aggregator influxdb Expected: pytest exit 0; rg는 대상 경로 삭제로 match가 없어 exit 1. - [ ] Step 5: 커밋 git add -A influxdb edge-orch/state-aggregator git commit -m "refactor: remove InfluxDB integration" ### Task 4: 현재 문서와 생성 HTML 최신화 Files: - Modify: docs/프로젝트-배경.md - Modify: docs/프로젝트-범위.md - Regenerate: docs/html/, docs/generated/consistency-report.html - Modify: tests/testdocshtmlsearch.py - Modify: tests/testdocsconsistency.py Interfaces: - Consumes: Tasks 13의 실제 코드, root render와 live readback - Produces: 여섯 Device inventory와 Core Data/PostgreSQL 단일 저장 경계를 설명하는 최신 문서 - [ ] Step 1: 문서 계약 테스트 갱신 운영 절차 fixture는 여섯 Device 이름, 단일 /dev/arduino-001, reader 1개, Core Data/PostgreSQL 저장 경계를 요구하고 현재형 InfluxDB/aggregate arduino-001 inventory 문구를 금지한다. -
